subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14-action grouped update land after targeted proof of the token, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker release paths, or should the security-sensitive families be split into separately validated pull requests?
rationale: The patch has no definite line-level defect, but it replaces executable third-party bundles in workflows holding secrets and release authority; only repository owners can accept that residual supply-chain and operational risk.

options.title: Validate and land the group
options.body: Rebase the PR and require targeted proof for the sensitive workflow families before approving the grouped immutable-pin update.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate Codex, App-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL updates from routine setup and maintenance actions for narrower proof and rollback.

options.title: Pause this refresh
options.body: Keep the existing pins until Dependabot access and current-head checks are stable enough to produce trustworthy validation.

recommendation.title: Validate and land the group
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and require targeted proof for the sensitive workflow families before approving the grouped immutable-pin update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person directly to release execution and validation on the highest-impact affected workflow.
